# Pull Request

## Description
Brief description of the changes in this PR.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue number)

## Changes Made
- [ ] List the specific changes made
- [ ] Include any new files added
- [ ] Mention any files modified

## Testing
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`make test`)
- [ ] All comprehensive test cases pass (`make testcases`)
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Manual testing completed

## Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows the project's style guidelines (`make fmt`)
- [ ] Self-review of the code completed
- [ ] Code is properly commented
- [ ] No new linting errors (`make vet`)

## Documentation
- [ ] Updated README.md if needed
- [ ] Updated AGENTS.md if agent behavior changed
- [ ] Updated CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Added/updated code comments

## Performance
- [ ] No performance regression introduced
- [ ] Benchmarks run if performance-critical changes made (`make bench`)

## Security
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities introduced
- [ ] Input validation added where necessary
- [ ] No sensitive information exposed

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines
- [ ] I have followed the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots to help explain your changes.
